title: LifecycleStates
description: GENERATED — do not hand-edit. Source: invoice-docs model/architecture/lifecycle-states.yaml (SDS §33.2; live requirement INV-REQ-570 / INV-NOTE-3#def:FR-AE.9). Regenerate with generate-lifecycle-states.py --write; the lifecycle-states-drift-check CI job fails if this file differs from what regeneration produces (INV-T-2859, T15). The `x-lifecycle-states` catalogue carries each state's full design metadata (meaning, whether it counts as unsubmitted for period readiness, whether it is in flight, and its terminality) verbatim from the source YAML, for a future Kotlin generator (gst.event-types, T3) the way error-codes.yaml already feeds the ErrorCode enum (CS-13); `documentLevelState` / `versionLevelState` / `lifecycleState` are the plain enums a wire schema (e.g. the obligation register entry, obligation-register-entry.schema.json) references by $ref.

documentLevelState.description: A document-level lifecycle state (SDS §33.2), before a submittable version exists.

versionLevelState.description: A version-level lifecycle state (SDS §33.2), once a payload version exists.

lifecycleState.description: Either level's lifecycle state (SDS §33.2) — document-level or version-level.

countsAsUnsubmitted.description: Free text (not a plain boolean in the source design record): whether and under what condition this state counts as unsubmitted for period-readiness computation (FR-AE.9).

terminal.description: Free text: 'No', 'Yes', or a condition under which the state stops being terminal (e.g. 'Until amended', 'Until superseded').

x-lifecycle-states.countsAsUnsubmitted: Yes, if in scope; while the scope verdict is unknown, counted provisionally from DocumentHeld (FR-AE.9)

x-lifecycle-states.meaning: Out of scope, Excluded Transaction, suppressed code (DS, OS, SRRC), before the obligation start (§33.7), rejected by the buyer (BUYER_REJECTED, FR-AE.27), or refused at Relay issuance and not yet corrected (ISSUANCE_REFUSED, FR-AE.2), or a credit note whose original was superseded before transmission by a revised invoice that nets it (NETTED_INTO_REVISION, FR-AE.19; added 25 Sep 2026)
AP or IRAS rejected; IRAS holds nothing for this version
x-lifecycle-states.countsAsUnsubmitted: Yes, unless an earlier version is ACKNOWLEDGED

x-lifecycle-states.meaning: Superseded by a newer version before being sent
A later version of the same UUID was acknowledged
Type 1A in Observe mode, awaiting acknowledgement (§33.1)
Withdrawn before any transmission, with approval (§33.3)
